title: Judgment Engines
description: Follow the hidden shift from generating text to granting scores and permissions; decompose judgment into norms, evidence, execution and consequence so the evaluator remains contestable.

readerInvitation.reasonToExist: Judgment Engines examines the systems that decide whether other outputs are good enough.
readerInvitation.readerPromise: Follow the hidden shift from generating text to granting scores and permissions; decompose judgment into norms, evidence, execution and consequence so the evaluator remains contestable.
readerOutcomes: Readers gain a vocabulary for discussing disagreement before averaging it into a single number.
This is the point where a convenient scoring tool becomes a demanding measurement problem.
Its reader gains come from comparing requirements rather than copying a verdict between unrelated contexts.

bookJourney.focus: Readers learn to examine the evaluator before trusting what its scores permit.
The standard becomes an inspectable evaluation program, rather than a list of adjectives.
The same division carries into evidence checking across the wider book.
Likewise, instructions inside a candidate must not acquire authority over its assessment.
Read it when choosing an evaluator also means deciding how much authority to delegate.
